messages:
sana: Heads-up — we have a customer demo Mon 09:00 PDT that needs an in-region burst of GPUs for a 1h load test. Asking about H100 availability in ap-southeast1 (SG).

alex: How many H100s exactly? and which project/cc?

sana: demo-project-redwood / CC-345. Need ~8x H100 (4 nodes) for ~1 hour. Can tolerate mixed nodes if perf is similar.

alex: Running quick checks on cloud quota and our dedicated pools. I can temporarily bump project quota to 4 GPUs, so we still need vendor capacity for the rest. Pinging rachel.

alex: quick note — I added an autoscale tweak to allow hot-add on the canary cluster (no restart).

rachel (vendor): Hi! vendor-rachel here — we have 4 H100 racks available in ap-sg. Full 8 H100s in-region will take ~72h to provision unless you accept mixed nodes (2x H100 + 4x A500) which we can reserve in ~24h. We can hold a mixed reservation with a 24h deposit.

sana: Prefer all H100 but mixed is acceptable for demo if it matches latency/throughput. What are perf deltas for A500?

rachel (vendor): A500s give ~60-75% token throughput vs H100 on our measurements for long sequences; lower memory for big contexts. If your demo is short-seq/chat style, mixing is OK.

mike: SRE here — fallback option: we can burst to our us-west dedicated pool (H100) via cross-region routing for the test. Adds ~30-50ms RTT; depends on demo SLAs. Thoughts?

sana: 30-50ms is borderline. Mixed nodes in-region > cross-region. We'll take mixed if we can cap bandwidth to simulate prod.

jess: Ops — if you need full in-region H100s, I can fast-track procurement/PO. Need final headcount + window to push to vendor priority.

sana: Final: go ahead and reserve mixed (2 H100 + 4 A500) for Mon 05:00 SGT -> hold 24h. I'll open ticket with perf targets and the cost center.

jess: Creating PO now. PO-9988. ETA on vendor allocation: https://vendor.example/alloc/PO-9988

alex: I created a temporary quota bump for demo-project-redwood (project-level reservation for 4 GPUs). Will link the reservation here.

sana: Thanks. rachel — please confirm reservation window once PO is posted.

rachel (vendor): Confirmed — holding mixed-reservation for PO-9988 for Mon 05:00 SGT. Please push the deposit by EOD to lock.

mike: Small canary: will limit demo network egress to 10Gbps to mimic production throttle. Also recommend a short smoke run 2h before demo.

sana: Good call. Scheduling smoke run at 03:00 SGT.

infra-bot: Notice: Reservation created for demo-project-redwood (4h, mixed nodes) by jess. Reservation ID: R-217000-55

jess: PO created + vendor link posted. Will follow up on deposit.

sana: Great work everyone — will update if anything changes. :thumbsup:
